body:
# FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile, Q3 2026 (DOCKET row dated 11/25 modeled; published 11/24)

| Series | Q1 26 | Q2 26 | Q3 26 | Reads |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Multifamily past due + nonaccrual, all banks | 1.479 | 1.404 | **1.742** | +34 bp in one quarter |
| Nonfarm nonresidential, all banks | 1.656 | 1.520 | 1.451 | falling |
| **Non-owner-occupied CRE, banks > $250B** | 3.403 | 3.076 | **2.781** | falling |
| same, $100B to $250B | 3.177 | 2.632 | 2.379 | falling |
| same, $10B to $100B | 1.237 | 1.077 | 0.947 | falling |
| same, $1B to $10B | 1.162 | 1.094 | 1.119 | up |
| same, < $1B | 1.533 | 1.484 | 1.378 | falling |
| Construction, credit card, auto | 1.401 / 3.081 / 2.641 | 1.342 / 2.811 / 2.777 | 1.423 / 2.989 / 2.858 | all up |
| **Reserve coverage, all** | 166.765 | 172.697 | **169.262** | down |
| coverage, $1B to $10B | 150.021 | 150.950 | **126.730** | down 24 points |
| coverage, $10B to $100B | 115.764 | 115.867 | 116.761 | flat |
| Noncurrent loans / Tier 1 plus reserves, $1B to $10B | 5.189 | 5.169 | **6.084** | up |
| OREO, $M | 4,599.5 | 4,906.2 | **5,413.6** | up |
| Problem banks | 54 | 47 | 39 | 4 failures in Q3 |
| DIF | 1.43% | 1.48% ($161.1B) | 1.50% ($163.5B) | Q3 loss provision $933M |

- Unrealized losses **$486B** from $326.7B (rates); net income $84.8B, ROA 1.28%; losses on securities sales; loans +7.5% on the year, NDFI and C&I the largest dollar growth; deposits +0.9%.
- **The gates:** CREED-T-03 grades on the **Table V-A nonfarm-nonresidential combined cell at banks over $250B**, which WALTER did not find in the spreadsheets. The chart series above is a different, episodic basis (back in Q3); it fell. Leg (c) coverage fell at the industry level (172.7 to 169.3), the first drop after Q2's rise. Both legs must hold together; **CREED decides**. REG-03 and the WQ-313 foreclosed-CRE question ($10B to $250B) are not answered by these sheets: only all-bank OREO is above.
- **So what:** the large-bank CRE read is better and the multifamily read is worse, with a sharp coverage drop in one size tier. Whether that tier move is one bank is not stated here; a single large nonaccrual can do it. REGINALD and HOMER check against Call Reports.
- Columns are the FDIC's Q3 release, so earlier quarters may carry revisions.

title: Bloomberg Nov 24: holders of every bond on two Hilton hotels in downtown Portland, including once-AAA notes, face a total loss; hotels appraised near $58M against $340.3M in 2019; a projection, not a realized loss
body:
# Hilton Portland Downtown and Duniway Portland

| Object | Figure | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Appraisal | about $58M combined, from $340.3M (2019): down 83%; date of the $58M not stated | Bloomberg 11/24 10:50 ET screenshot |
| Debt | about $240M single-asset CMBS, 2019; 'less than one-quarter of their debt load' is $58M against the debt plus costs | Propmodo 11/24 |
| Servicer advances and costs | $53M, unbroken | Propmodo |
| Title | Brookfield default 2020; foreclosure to the trust 2023 (Propmodo also says Brookfield affiliates own it: unresolved) | Propmodo |
| Plan | SitusAMC: minor improvements, wait for a 2027 to 2028 recovery; three comparable hotels in escrow | Propmodo |
| Earlier appraisal | $254.8M from $297.7M (CRE News 9/5/2023) | teaser |
| Market | CBD occupancy 62.9% October 2026 vs 79.5% October 2019 | Propmodo |

- **State: projected, not booked.** 'Any sale at the current valuation would leave little to no proceeds' (bookmark quote). Holders and deal name not given.
- **So what:** a hotel in a distressed downtown, not an office read; the precedent is a once-AAA slice taking a full loss. Barclays: more than $36B of single-asset CMBS reaches final maturity in 2027 (Propmodo). Pair with the 11.74% special-servicing rate below.
- **Trepp-type aggregate (no case):** CMBS in special servicing 11.74% in October, 11.49% September, 10.84% a year ago; office 16.60% (bookmark text, source chart unread).

title: Follow-up to 006: UKMTO Warning 219-26 dates the three-ship attack to 22 Nov 20:25 UTC (time-late, 'Verified'); ADNOC port notice dated Nov 23 bans tanker transit through its waters except calls at its ports, 90 days; US embassies reissue security alerts across the region
body:
# Gulf follow-up

| Item | Read | Status |
|---|---|---|
| UKMTO 219-26 | 'Incident Date: 22 Nov 2026, 2025UTC, Source: Verified... time-late report... three vessels were struck by unknown projectiles whilst transiting eastbound'; crews accounted for, damage unknown | image of the warning (bookmark, Rory Johnston). **Resolves 006's date conflict:** 20:25 UTC Sunday is 00:25 Monday Gulf local (clock collision guard). One event of three ships |
| ADNOC PPA notice JDR/MN/023/2026, 23/11/2026, Jebel Dhanna Ruwais harbour master | tankers with crude, products, gases, chemicals, **including UAE-flagged**, 'prohibited from entering, crossing, stopping, waiting or transiting within ADNOC-PPA controlled waters unless calling at or conducting approved business with ADNOC-PPA ports/Terminals'; names Ruwais, Jebel Dhanna, Das, Zirku, Mubarraz; effective from Circular (07) and Ministerial Resolution (4/S) of 12.11.2026; 90 days | image of the notice (bookmark). **Does not name Fujairah;** 'implications for STS at Fujairah' is the poster's question. Original notice not found on adnoc.ae |
| US embassy security alerts Nov 24 | Israel, Kuwait, Bahrain, UAE and others: 'hostilities have the potential to escalate rapidly', airspace, shelter; cites attacks on US assets in Bahrain and Kuwait and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia | search summary; OSAC page unread. Similar Nov 7 and Nov 22 alerts: **reissue, not proof of a new threat** |
| Houthi claim, Petro Rabigh refinery | Sun Nov 22 claim; Saudi no confirmation | CLAIM-ONLY (Breitbart, Archyde search) |
| Makkah region | ballistic missile toward the western region destroyed (coalition, 11/23) | INTERCEPTED |
| Trump on Iran | Thursday remarks: 'We'll see what happens after 1 January'; inclination to resume strikes if no deal by year end (Daily Beast). CBS: Israel and the US weighing a near-term assault | secondary; **do not write 'postponed to 2027' as a decision** |

- FALCON: count the three hulls only against 219-26. BRENT: the ADNOC notice constrains waiting and STS in Abu Dhabi waters; volumes unstated.
